name: elagoht/markdown
description: A collage plugin that makes a directory of Markdown files page data.
setup: Documents are read from an `fs.FS`, and pages read them through the plugin: keep it in a variable in `plugins.go` — `md := markdown.New(markdown.Options{FS: ...})` — so pages can use `md.Handler()` and `md.IndexHandler()`, put `md` in the plugins list, and set `"dir"` when the documents are not at the filesystem's root.

config.description: A collage plugin that makes a directory of Markdown files page data.

dir.description: Dir is the directory in FS whose *.md files are the documents: one file per document, named for its slug. Subdirectories are not read, so a translation can live in one. Default ".".

drafts.description: Drafts includes documents whose front matter says draft: true. Off, a draft is not listed, not built, and answers 404.

localeDirs.description: LocaleDirs gives a locale its own directory: {"tr": "content/blog/tr"}. A locale not named reads Dir.

unsafe.description: Unsafe lets raw HTML written in the Markdown through to the page. Off, it is left out, so a document cannot put a script on the site.
